_readme: Tours shown on 3ukph.com/tours. While live is false, the public page shows 'coming soon' with a general inquiry form; the tour cards show only at /tours?preview=1. Replace the sample tours with TripHappy's real Top 5 Local and Top 5 International, then set live to true. price: number in pesos, or null for 'Price on request'. image: optional https URL.

tours.name: Oslob Whale Shark Watching and Tumalog Falls
tours.blurb: Swim near gentle whale sharks in the morning, then cool off at the curtain-like Tumalog Falls.

tours.name: Kawasan Falls Canyoneering and Moalboal Sardine Run
tours.blurb: Jump, slide and swim down turquoise canyons, then snorkel with a million sardines and sea turtles.

tours.name: Bohol Countryside Day Tour
tours.blurb: Chocolate Hills, the tarsiers, the Loboc River cruise and old stone churches in one easy day.

tours.name: Cebu City Heritage and Highlands Tour
tours.blurb: Magellan's Cross, Basilica del Santo Niño, Temple of Leah and the city lights from Tops.

tours.name: Bantayan Island Getaway
tours.blurb: White sand, calm water and slow island days in the north of Cebu.

tours.name: Japan: Tokyo, Kyoto and Osaka
tours.blurb: Shrines, food streets and the bullet train. Visa help and itinerary planned with you.

tours.name: South Korea: Seoul and Nami Island
tours.blurb: Palaces, K-culture, cafés and seasonal views on Nami Island.

tours.name: Vietnam: Da Nang, Hoi An and Ba Na Hills
tours.blurb: Golden Bridge, lantern-lit Hoi An and beaches, short and easy from Manila or Cebu.

tours.name: Thailand: Bangkok and Pattaya
tours.blurb: Temples, floating markets, street food and island hopping off Pattaya.

tours.name: Singapore City Escape
tours.blurb: Gardens by the Bay, Sentosa and hawker food, perfect for families.
